root_cause: The Source Universe runtime and production data path were live, but Loop Assurance only inferred four of eight required stages from cron/runtime evidence. Action, outcome, learning and guard therefore stayed missing even when their truthful result was an explicit no-op or a passed security boundary.

architecture.closure: runtime-event trigger -> truthful action/outcome/learning readback + fail-closed guard receipt

prevention: Do not force action or outcome creation merely to satisfy assurance completeness.
Record explicit no-op evidence when the canonical truth gate correctly blocks action, outcome or learning.
Delete the fresh guard receipt immediately when RLS, browser revokes, privileged execute boundaries or truth flags fail.
Reuse the existing runtime event and Loop Assurance tables; do not create another scheduler or assurance authority.
